newsitem.title: UK: US STOCKS MOSTLY FLAT IN LONDON, APPLE UP.
newsitem.headline: US STOCKS MOSTLY FLAT IN LONDON, APPLE UP.

text.p: Shares in Apple Computer Inc resumed their advance in London on Thursday after software giant Microsoft Corp announced on Wednesday a historic $150 million investment in the struggling computer maker, dealers said.
In an otherwise dull market, Apple shares rose $9/16 to $27 in London, after jumping $6-9/16, they said.
"We're not seeing much in the other (technology stocks), but it looks like they're probably set for another good run today," said one London broker.
The Nasdaq composite index, laden with high-technology stocks, rose 8.91 points to a record 1,630.44 on Wednesday. It was the sixth consecutive session the index scored a record peak.
The Dow also climbed to a new record, gaining 71.77 points to 8,259.31.
London dealers were looking for a higher open on Wall Street, although the open could be influenced by data on weekly jobless claims, due for release at 1230 GMT.
Data on wholesale trade and consumer credit are due later in the day.
"Everything else is pretty flat...All of the focus is on Apple," he added.
In other trading, September S&P 500 index futures were up 0.50 point to 964.10 on Globex at 1050 GMT. September long bond futures were up 1/32 to 114-25/32.
